title: Optometrists
description: Diagnose, manage, and treat conditions and diseases of the human eye and visual system. Examine eyes and visual system, diagnose problems or impairments, prescribe corrective lenses, and provide treatment. May prescribe therapeutic drugs to treat specific eye conditions.

tasks.text: Examine eyes, using observation, instruments, and pharmaceutical agents, to determine visual acuity and perception, focus, and coordination and to diagnose diseases and other abnormalities, such as glaucoma or color blindness.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Analyze test results and develop a treatment plan.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Prescribe, supply, fit and adjust eyeglasses, contact lenses, and other vision aids.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Device prescription needs clinical assessment and accountability

dwas.name: Fit eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other vision aids.
Prescribe assistive medical devices or related treatments.

tasks.text: Prescribe medications to treat eye diseases if state laws permit.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing medications is licensed high-stakes judgment

tasks.text: Educate and counsel patients on contact lens care, visual hygiene, lighting arrangements, and safety factors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Caregiver technique training is live and relational

dwas.name: Train patients, family members, or caregivers in techniques for managing disabilities or illnesses.

tasks.text: Remove foreign bodies from the eye.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on treatment of acute conditions

dwas.name: Treat acute illnesses, infections, or injuries.

tasks.text: Provide patients undergoing eye surgeries, such as cataract and laser vision correction, with pre- and post-operative care.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Post-surgical monitoring is hands-on clinical observation

dwas.name: Monitor patients following surgeries or other treatments.

tasks.text: Consult with and refer patients to ophthalmologist or other health care practitioner if additional medical treatment is determined necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Prescribe therapeutic procedures to correct or conserve vision.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing therapy requires licensed clinical accountability

tasks.text: Provide vision therapy and low-vision rehabilitation.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Chronic disease management needs clinical judgment
